text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, or at least an earlier dinner.

**2. CRM quality improved.** Notes were consistent, searchable, and actually complete. Managers stopped chasing updates.

**3. Consent matters.** Some buyers hesitated on recording. Reps who explained the "why" upfront saw far fewer objections.

**4. Summaries need a human glance.** Accuracy was strong, but names and next steps still needed a quick check.

**5. Adoption followed trust.** Usage climbed once leaders shared their own call summaries.

Our takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment in the room. It protects the attention you bring to it.

What's your team learned from AI pilots?
